about: Through real cargo metadata and each member manifest read as TOML: a member without [lints] workspace = true, one with its own [lints.<tool>] table (cargo refuses it beside workspace = true, so it also lacks that) and one that may be published are each a site at its Cargo.toml; a member inheriting the lints with publish = false is none (AF10)

files.clean/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "clean"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[lints]
workspace = true
files.own-lints/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "own-lints"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
